title: Team Context
new: Invite a team to an intake
intro: Independent perspectives on your collaboration. No assessment of quality, no ranking.
newTeam: Create a new team after confirmation
existingHelp: Existing teams are offered only with effective team access. Enter all members’ email addresses as well. A new round does not change an earlier one.
emails: Email addresses of 2 to 4 founders (one per line)
reviewerHelp: For an organisation: you and the active members selected here receive access. Other organisation members cannot see answers. This selection stays fixed for this round.
failed: not sent – share the personal link directly
inviteIntro: Open the invitation using the account with the invited email address. You will then see the team, full roster and named reviewers before deciding to participate. This does not share any answers.
invalidInvite: This invitation is no longer valid or belongs to a different verified email address.
confirmHelp: Everyone must first open their invitation. Then confirm this specific team and the entire roster. Independent answers begin only after everyone has confirmed.
confirmCheck: I confirm this team, all named founders and the listed reviewers.
recipients: These reviewers can read after everyone has submitted:
scope: Shared area: all named founders in this round and the named reviewers will see the released original answers. Confidential conversation notes are visible only to you and the named reviewers. Drafts are visible only to you.
freeze: Different participants or reviewers require a new round.
withdrawCheck: I want to end future access to this entire round.
withdrawHelp: Withdrawal ends future content access for everyone. Content already read or saved outside the application cannot be recalled.
withdrawn: This round has ended. Answers are no longer displayed.
waiting: Your submission is saved. Shared answers become visible only after all founders have submitted and authorised release.
advisorWaiting: Until everyone has submitted, you can see organisational progress only, not answers or confidential notes.
factsTitle: How did you come together as a founding team?
factsHelp: Help your team and your advisors understand your starting point: how did you know each other, what already existed, and when did you begin working on this venture together? Knowing each other for a long or short time is not a quality judgement.
requiredHelp: Only the short factual context is required. Approximate dates or “not exactly known” are enough. All reflections and conversation notes are optional.
previewHelp: Check your original answers and recipients. Submitting authorises shared publication once everyone has submitted. Your answers cannot then be silently changed.
release: I authorise sharing my common answers with all named founders and reviewers once everyone has submitted. I share my optional confidential note with the named reviewers only.
privateRequest: I would like to discuss a point confidentially with my advisors.
privateHelp: Other founders see neither this content nor an indication that you entered anything here. Named reviewers see it only after the round is fully published.
privateNone: No confidential conversation notes available for you.
history: How you know each other and what you have done together
perspectives: What you appreciate and the contributions you see in each other
motivationSection: Why you want to build together / your collaboration
conversationHelp: Discuss the original perspectives and voluntarily shared open points. Differences are not a quality judgement, and agreement is not proof of team quality.
copyTitle: Reuse your own relevant team history
copyHelp: Only your factual context from an earlier shared round for the same team is copied. Current factual fields are replaced; reflections and confidential notes are not copied.
resend: Create a new invitation link / resend
error: The action could not be completed. Check your entries, account, required facts and current round status. A failed submission does not remove your draft.
topicsHelp: Select “none at present” or “discuss in conversation” on its own.

fields.origin: How do you know each other?
fields.since: Since approximately when have you known each other?
fields.worked: Have you previously worked or built something together?
fields.work_context: If yes: roughly what, and in what setting?
fields.formation: How did this particular founding team come together?
fields.venture_since: Since approximately when have you worked on this venture together?
fields.existed: Did the venture exist before this team came together?
fields.appreciation: What do you appreciate about working with this person / their way of working?
fields.contribution: What concrete strength or contribution do you see in this person?
fields.complement: How does this person complement you from your perspective?
fields.motivation: Why do you want to build with this particular group?
fields.open_topics: Which points are not yet fully clarified?
fields.open_text: Optional brief context for open points
fields.works_well: What works particularly well in your collaboration?
fields.team_clarity: What should become clearer between you as a team?
fields.clarity: What should become clearer between you and this person?
fields.unused_strength: Which strength of this person could the team make more use of?

formations.together: We already knew each other and developed the idea together.
formations.joined: One person already had an idea / venture; others joined later.
formations.cofounder_search: We met specifically as potential co-founders.
formations.network: We met through matching / an accelerator / a programme / a network.
formations.prior_work: The venture grew out of previous collaboration.

topics.conversation: I would prefer to discuss this in conversation

requiredWhenYes: Required if you selected Yes above
